features.name: Analysis Assist
features.description: Copilot-powered capability that helps users create analytical views using natural language. Users describe what analysis they want, and Copilot generates the appropriate columns, filtering, sorting, and grouping without requiring manual clicks and keystrokes.
features.status_evidence_quote: that's why we're excited to announce the public preview of analysis assist
caveats: Only works on lists that already support analyzing data
Only works with fields visible on the current page or table
Does not join data across multiple tables
Available on list pages and worksheets only
Business Central Online only, not on-premises
English language only at this stage
Not available in Canada for regulatory reasons
Requires version 24.0 or later
User must have permission to analyze
Copilot may suggest features the user did not ask for
Draft tabs marked with dotted line until saved
Tab only saves when explicitly confirmed
Copilot may add more columns than requested when pivoting
Requires Copilot to correctly infer the intended field
AI is sometimes incorrect
Users should review generated content before committing

features.name: Analyze List Action
features.description: New copilot menu action at the top of lists that opens a dialog allowing users to specify what kind of analysis they want using natural language input.
features.status_evidence_quote: the public preview of analysis assist

features.name: Draft Tab Management
features.description: Generated analysis tabs start in draft mode with a dotted underline, allowing users to iterate and refine. Users can navigate between iterations using back and forward arrows, or keep and save the final version.
features.status_evidence_quote: the public preview of analysis assist
caveats: Tab only saves when explicitly confirmed

features.name: Semantic Understanding for Filters
features.description: Copilot can understand user intent even when terminology differs. For example, when user said replacement but the field is substitution, Copilot figured out the mapping and applied the correct filter.
features.status_evidence_quote: the public preview of analysis assist
caveats: Requires Copilot to correctly infer the intended field

features.name: Prompt Guide
features.description: Helper interface showing users example prompts for common analysis operations including grouping, pivoting, showing fields, sorting, filtering, freezing columns, and renaming tabs.
features.status_evidence_quote: the public preview of analysis assist

features.name: Grouping and Pivoting
features.description: Copilot can create analysis grouped or pivoted by specified fields. Users can ask to group by vendor, reformat as pivot, or add other structural transformations to data.
features.status_evidence_quote: the public preview of analysis assist
caveats: Copilot may add more columns than requested when pivoting

features.name: Data Privacy in Analysis Assist
features.description: Copilot does not send customer data to generate analyses. Only the schema (description of available columns) is sent, and Copilot generates the analysis structure which is then populated with data client-side.

features.name: Copilot availability and deployment
features.description: Copilot features are available exclusively for Business Central Online, released with 2024 Wave 1 (version 24.0 or later), rolled out for most localizations except Canada, and available in English language only at no additional cost with the Business Central license.
features.status_evidence_quote: this has been released with 2024 release Wave 1 so you'll need to upgrade to version 24.0 or later
caveats: Business Central Online only
English language only
Not available in Canada
Requires version 24.0 or later

features.name: Responsible AI and data safety
features.description: Copilot is designed on Microsoft's responsible AI standards. Customer data is not used to train AI models, security and privacy controls are in place, and only generated layouts are created without new data generation. Users can review and approve all Copilot-generated content before saving.
caveats: AI is sometimes incorrect
Users should review generated content before committing

features.name: Copilot feature enablement and troubleshooting
features.description: Admins can control Copilot features via the Copilot and AI capabilities page. Features require opt-in for data movement outside geographic boundaries in regions where Azure OpenAI is not available. Permission sets govern user ability to analyze lists.
caveats: Azure OpenAI service available in limited regions only
Customers must opt-in to data movement outside geographic boundaries
Language must be set to English
Specific permission set required for analyze capability

features.name: Copilot for sales document entry
features.description: Copilot helps users get more efficient with entering sales lines in sales documents.

features.name: Copilot chat for data discovery and learning
features.description: Users can chat with Copilot to find data in Business Central, learn new skills, ask how to do things, and explain concepts.

features.name: Copilot for electronic invoice matching
features.description: Copilot assists with electronic invoice matching capabilities.

features.name: Excel reports for finance and sales
features.description: New Excel reports for finance and sales with Copilot integration to help users draft multilingual Excel reports. Includes new Excel layout capabilities for developers.
